text:
elaine: Quick sync  PR #432 toggles the new structured-output examples for tool-calling. I left TODOs for Python + TS snippets and one note about nullable tool outputs. Can folks pick up pieces?

sam: I can take the TS SDK snippets. Do we prefer the promise-based example or async iterator streaming?

elaine: Prefer promise-based for the basic quickstart, but add a small streaming example under an "Advanced" heading. Keep both <100 lines.

chris: I'll do the Python snippet and add a unit test that validates schema parsing for arrays/unions. One ask: do we want to show the union-as-object pattern or union-typed-array shim?

maria: For readability in docs, show the union-as-object (tagged unions) first, then mention the shim for older runtimes. Also include an example with nullable tool output (tool may return null on no-op).

jordyn: Heads up  in the existing page the JSON Schema link points to /docs/schema-old which is wrong. I found the canonical schema at /docs/structured-output/schema-v2. I'll put a tiny link-fix PR but need approval.

elaine: @jordyn please open the link-fix PR and @chris please coordinate the test expectations with that canonical schema URL.

chris: Will do. Also adding a short note about parser fallback order (1) strict schema, (2) lax parse with heuristics, (3) call tool again. Example snippet included.

sam: Draft TS snippet (pasted here for quick review):
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });

const res = await client.call({
  model: 'rw-chat-1',
  input: 'Create a JSON object responding to user intent',
  structuredOutput: { schema: { type: 'object', properties: { action: { type: 'string' }, payload: { type: ['object', 'null'] } }, required: ['action'] } }
});
console.log(res.structuredOutput);
```

sam: (this shows nullable payload, per Maria's ask)

maria: LGTM but add a tiny line showing how to handle null in app code: `if (!res.structuredOutput.payload) { /* noop */ }`

elaine: Good. Chris  add a Python test that asserts `payload is None` case and that the parser doesn't raise.

chris: Added test + a small doc blurb: "When a tool returns null for payload, Redwood's structured parser treats it as an explicit no-op. Use fallback policies to retry or return a safe default."

jordyn: Link-fix PR opened: #437  replaces /docs/schema-old -> /docs/structured-output/schema-v2 and updates two internal anchors. Tagging @elaine for final review.

docs-bot: PR #432 updated with commits from chris, sam, and jordyn. Checks: lint , build ⚠️ (1 warning related to example code fence), accessibility .

elaine: I'll take a look at #437 and #432 later today. If all green, aim to merge by EOD so platform docs sync can pick up next release. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

sam: I'll prepare the streaming TS snippet as a follow-up PR (small, separate).

maria: I'll add a note in the migration guide about the nullable-tool-output semantics and include a short testing checklist.

chris: Merged unit test branch to the PR, re-running checks.

docs-bot: CI passed for #432. Ready for merge when approvals are in place.

elaine: Ok locking this thread — final reviewers please approve if you're happy so we can roll this into the docs release.
